Subject: Urgent: PinnacleTrust enterprise activation — feature lift request

Team —

Quick context: PinnacleTrust (large regional bank) is our largest close this quarter if we can meet two asks in the activation SOW. Rishi is on the thread with me but I wanted to pull Product/Eng in early. Summary of asks from them: 

- Deterministic model affinity for a named model family (low-drift) with pinning per-tenant for 12 months
- Retention of token-level telemetry (30 days) with an audited export path for specific accounts

Why this matters: legal/procurement will only sign the 6-month reserved commit if the SOW includes the model affinity guarantee and a retention/export workflow they can audit. They are starting procurement review this week; the customer deadline for contract signature is EOD Friday (2027-06-11).

Proposed immediate asks for Product/Eng:
- Can Product scope an MVP for pinned-model affinity with safe fallback within 2 sprints?
- What minimal telemetry export surface do we need to satisfy their audit team?
- Any blockers for including this in a Dedicated onboarding path (security review and KMS)?

I've attached the SOW summary and a very rough spec sketch from Rishi's call with the customer. Rishi: they expect us to confirm feasibility today so they can accelerate procurement.

Thanks —
Lauren

Thanks Lauren — quick follow ups from Product so we can scope an MVP: 

1) Acceptance criteria: what constitutes "model affinity" for them? Is it a strict one-model-only enforcement, or "preferred" routing with guaranteed fallback SLA?
2) Traffic profile: expected RPS and peak concurrency during onboarding and after go-live (numbers or ranges, per Rishi)
3) Telemetry: which token-level fields do they require in the export (e.g., prompt, response, token-level timestamps, trace IDs)? Any PII redaction requirements?
4) Compliance path: do they require us to store exports in their S3, or is a signed export delivered to them acceptable?

If we can get answers to the above within a few hours we can produce a narrow scope (3–5 engineer-days) proposal for a canary-grade MVP. Otherwise I'll scope a conservative two-sprint plan.

TL;DR: feasible with constrained scope; details below.

Hi team —

Initial engineering take: we can deliver a pinned-model affinity MVP that routes by-tenant to a pinned model instance and falls back to a compatible model family when unavailable. Key notes: 

- Work items (high level): tenant routing rule, config UI/infra flag (per-tenant model id), compatibility matrix check + auto-fallback, testing harness for affinity enforcement.
- Estimated effort: ~7 engineer-days to deliver canary (single-region, limited tenants), ~2 sprints to harden for Dedicated production (SLA + observability).
- Risk: KV cache coherency for long-lived affinities and cross-region failover; we'll need to add a small TTL-based revalidation to avoid silent drift.
- Telemetry export: token-level export (prompt+response+per-token timestamps+trace id) is straightforward; privacy: we need a clear redaction policy if they request PII removed at export time. Export delivery options: push to their S3 (preferred), or signed, time-limited download link from our infra.

Constraints: current sprint is near capacity — if we prioritize this as a canary task we can have a working demo in 10 business days. If they require full Dedicated-hardening (KMS integration + audit hooks), that becomes a 4–5 week workstream.

Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Serving Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

Thanks all — following up with concrete numbers from the customer call yesterday: 

- Expected steady state: 12 rps average, ~60 concurrent during peak trading-window bursts.
- Initial onboarding: 2 tenants (pilot), then ramp to ~8 over 3 months.
- Model requirement: they want "Model-X v3" pinned per-tenant; acceptable fallback is any Model-X family instance, but they will escalate if affinity fails more than 0.1% of inference requests over a week.
- Telemetry: audit team asked for prompt+response+token timestamps+trace id. They explicitly asked for a 30-day retention window and ability to prove export delivery.
- Commercial: they're prepared to sign a 6-month Dedicated commit at $45k/mo if we can get canary in 2 weeks and Dedicated-ready work started within 4 weeks. Deal ID: PIN-2027-0457.

I can attach the procurement draft if helpful. They need a feasibility confirmation to procurement by Thursday EOD (2027-06-10) to keep the SLA window.

—Rishi
